recipes.name: Chocolate mug sponge
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:cocoa-powder}} in a large mug.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:vegetable-oil}} with a fork until smooth.
Microwave on high 90 seconds, until risen and set on top.
Leave 1 minute before eating.

recipes.name: Microwave jacket potatoes with cheese and beans
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher. For crisp skins, finish in a hot oven 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Prick {{ing:potato-large}} all over with a fork.
Microwave on high 10 minutes, turning halfway, until soft all through.
Heat {{ing:baked-beans}} in a covered bowl 2 minutes, stirring once.
Split the potatoes. Add {{ing:butter-unsalted}}, the beans and grated {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.

recipes.name: Microwave porridge with banana
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:oats-rolled}} and {{ing:milk-semi-skimmed}} in a large bowl.
steps.note: A big bowl stops it boiling over.

steps.instruction: Microwave on high 2 minutes. Stir.
Microwave 1 minute more, until thick and creamy.
Slice {{ing:banana-medium}} on top. Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}.

recipes.name: Microwave scrambled eggs on toast
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher. Take them out slightly wet; they finish cooking in the bowl.

steps.instruction: Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} in a bowl. Add {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.
Microwave on high 40 seconds. Stir with a fork.
Microwave 30 seconds more. Stir. Repeat until barely set.
Toast {{ing:bread-slice-medium}}. Spoon the eggs on top. Snip over {{ing:chives}}.

recipes.name: Microwave mushroom risotto
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Put in a large bowl with {{ing:butter-unsalted}}. Microwave 2 minutes.
Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Add with {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}}. Stir to coat.
Add half of {{ing:stock-vegetable}}, hot. Cover loosely. Microwave 6 minutes.
Stir. Add the rest of the stock. Microwave 6 minutes more, until the rice is tender.
Stir in grated {{ing:parmesan}}. Leave 2 minutes to thicken.

swaps.text: A vegetarian hard cheese: most parmesan is made with animal rennet

recipes.name: Microwave salmon with ginger and soy
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Halve {{ing:pak-choi}}. Lay in a shallow dish.
Put {{ing:salmon-fillet}} on top. Spoon over {{ing:soy-sauce}} and grated {{ing:ginger-fresh}}.
Cover with a plate. Microwave on high 4 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Heat {{ing:rice-white-cooked}} for the time on the pouch.
Scatter sliced {{ing:spring-onion}} over the fish. Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Microwave macaroni cheese
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:penne-dry}} and {{ing:water}} in a large bowl.
Microwave on high 10 minutes, stirring halfway, until the pasta is tender. Drain any water left.
Stir in {{ing:milk-whole}}, grated {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Microwave 1 minute. Stir until smooth and saucy.

recipes.name: Microwave golden syrup sponge
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Grease a 1 litre microwave-safe bowl. Spoon {{ing:golden-syrup}} into the bottom.
Beat soft {{ing:butter-unsalted}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:milk-whole}}. Spoon over the syrup.
Cover loosely. Microwave on high 4 minutes, until risen and springy.
Leave 2 minutes. Turn out onto a plate.

recipes.name: Microwave steamed greens with lemon
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:broccoli-head}} into florets. Put in a bowl with {{ing:green-beans}} and 2 tbsp water.
Cover with a plate. Microwave on high 4 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Drain.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Microwave sweet potato with black beans
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Prick {{ing:sweet-potato}} all over.
Microwave on high 8 minutes, turning halfway, until soft.
Heat drained {{ing:black-beans-tinned}} with {{ing:cumin-ground}} in a covered bowl 2 minutes.
Split the potatoes. Fill with the beans and {{ing:salsa-dip}}. Squeeze over {{ing:lime}}.

recipes.name: Microwave chilli con carne
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Put in a large bowl with {{ing:beef-mince-5-fat}}.
Microwave on high 5 minutes, breaking up the mince with a fork halfway.
Stir in {{ing:chilli-powder}}, {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and drained {{ing:kidney-beans-tinned}}.
Cover loosely. Microwave 8 minutes, stirring halfway, until thick and the meat is cooked through.
Heat {{ing:rice-white-cooked}} for the time on the pouch.

recipes.name: Microwave baked apple
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Core {{ing:apple-medium}}. Score a line round the middle of each.
Mix {{ing:sultanas}} with {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}. Stuff into the apples.
Stand in a dish. Pour over {{ing:maple-syrup}}.
Cover. Microwave on high 4 minutes, until soft.

recipes.name: Microwave coconut dal
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Rinse {{ing:lentils-red-dry}}. Put in a large bowl with {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}, {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:curry-powder}}.
Crush in {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Cover loosely. Microwave on high 15 minutes, stirring every 5, until the lentils collapse.
Stir in {{ing:spinach}}. Microwave 1 minute more.

recipes.name: Lemon curd mug pudding
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a large mug.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:milk-whole}}, {{ing:vegetable-oil}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Microwave on high 75 seconds, until risen.
Squeeze over a little of the lemon juice.

recipes.name: Vanilla mug sponge with jam
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a large mug.

Stir in {{ing:jam-strawberry}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}, chopped or mashed as needed.
Microwave on high 90 seconds, until risen and set on top.
Leave 1 minute before eating.

recipes.name: Microwave jacket potato with tuna mayonnaise
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Prick {{ing:potato-large}} all over with a fork.
Microwave on high 10 minutes, turning halfway, until soft all through.
Mix {{ing:tuna-tinned-in-spring-water}} and {{ing:mayonnaise}} and {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}} in a bowl. Microwave 1 minute if it should be hot.
Split the potatoes. Pile in the filling.

Mix {{ing:kidney-beans-tinned}} and {{ing:passata}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}} in a bowl. Microwave 1 minute if it should be hot.

recipes.name: Microwave cod with cherry tomatoes
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Lay {{ing:cod-fillet}} in a dish with halved {{ing:cherry-tomato}}, {{ing:olives-pitted}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Cover. Microwave on high 4 minutes, until the fish flakes. Tear over {{ing:fresh-basil}}.

recipes.name: Microwave corn on the cob
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Wrap each of {{ing:corn-on-the-cob}} in damp kitchen paper.
Microwave on high 4 minutes. Roll in {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.

recipes.name: Microwave lemon curd
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Whisk the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, melted {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:egg-medium}} in a bowl.
Microwave on high in 1-minute bursts, whisking between, about 4 minutes, until thick.

recipes.name: Microwave minted peas
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:peas-frozen}} in a bowl with 2 tbsp water. Cover.
Microwave on high 4 minutes. Stir in {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Microwave egg and vegetable rice
recipes.method_note: Times are for an 800 W microwave. Add a little longer at lower power, a little less at higher.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:rice-white-cooked}}, {{ing:peas-frozen}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}} in a bowl. Microwave 2 minutes.
Stir in beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Microwave 1 minute, stir, then 1 minute more. Top with {{ing:spring-onion}}.
